quartz.rationale: The legacy adapter has explicit registered goals and no registered required goals or deliverables to fail its checks. Loaded predicate condition 1 instead derives requirements from the signed order: optional G4 cannot satisfy mandatory R8 coverage, and R3 and R5 are absent.

maple.rationale: The registered required goals have current passing criteria and usable outputs, so the legacy adapter passes. Loaded predicate condition 1 uses the signed order independently of the registry: the mandatory printable sampling checklist, R3, remains unrepresented.

orchid.rationale: The signed amendment replaces R5 with R6, and all current mandatory outcomes have required goals with passing criteria and usable outputs. X16 concerns another order and does not bind this release.

linen.rationale: All mandatory outputs are verified, so the registry-local legacy adapter passes. Loaded predicate condition 6 and the final-transition authority guard block publication: S81 binds this order and became durable before any notification was committed.
